defects: Source depth exceeds target by 0.23 inches.
Board grain is too weak to distinguish timber members.
Drawer and vise hardware read as simple blocks and buttons.
hard_fail_reasons: The source GLB is 58 x 36 x 30.23 inches; the ArtBrief depth is exactly 30 inches.
The approved target’s end-grain treatment, visibly fitted joinery and shoulder-vise hardware are not transferred.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with room_elevated_workbench-v006, room_elevated_workbench-v007 is a useful challenger but does not clear the target’s strict transfer gate. The authored joinery is a real geometry improvement; its finish, craft and exact depth need another pass.
next_action_hypothesis: Move the drawer bank inward enough to fit the 30-inch depth exactly; deepen the breadboard/end-grain assembly and vise details, use stronger French-oak grain with location-seeded UV variation, and retain the fitted shoulders and pegs.

observations.art_direction_fit: The warmer timber and fitted frame move toward the concept, but the flat finish and missing end-grain treatment remain conspicuous.
observations.close_up_quality: The detail render shows simple drawer faces and small round pulls; it does not carry the target’s sculpted joinery and visible vise hardware.
observations.gameplay_readability: At gameplay distance the bench and its dog-hole work surface remain easy to identify.
observations.geometric_detail: The candidate adds dog holes, three fitted drawer fronts, peg shoulders and lower stretchers; the routed faces and joinery still appear as repeated rectangular pieces.
observations.material_realism: The oak/walnut split is legible, but the oak finish appears smooth and nearly uniform beside the approved target’s figured boards.
observations.proportion: The room render normalizes the bench to its RoomDefinition envelope, while the source GLB depth is 30.23 inches rather than the exact 30-inch ArtBrief depth.
observations.scale_fidelity: The Room B review render places the bench at the expected gameplay scale, although the source depth overshoots the brief by 0.23 inches.
observations.semantic_recognizability: v007 reads as a substantial woodworking bench in its Room B gameplay and three-quarter captures.
observations.silhouette_quality: The wide slab, four legs, apron and lower frame establish the correct workbench silhouette, but the target has more shaped transitions and end-grain blocks.
observations.surface_variation: The tabletop and members do not show the target’s distinct board grain and end-grain blocks in the production captures.
observations.technical_integration: Godot imports and renders the GLB with no reported importer issues; the measured source depth is 30.23 inches and requires correction before promotion.

close_inspection.evidence: The registered detail capture for room_elevated_workbench-v007 shows shallow construction relief, weak material variation and missing target-level joinery.

edge_treatment.evidence: room_elevated_workbench-v007 shows simple, repeated edges in its registered gameplay, three-quarter and detail renders; the target’s more deliberate shaping is not present.

hardware.evidence: room_elevated_workbench-v007 does not make the target’s specified functional hardware clearly readable; visible small buttons/plates do not substitute for the cup pulls, hinges or vise fittings.

joins.evidence: room_elevated_workbench-v007 does not show fitted joints with enough relief to match the approved target in the registered production views.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: The registered close view shows shallow, regular details rather than the target’s fitted rails, panels and drawer construction.

material_response.evidence: The production views show separated wood tones but a smooth, uniform response compared with the approved target’s finished timber.

surface_variation.evidence: The registered production captures do not show convincing per-board grain or surface wear for room_elevated_workbench-v007.

thickness.evidence: The registered views show plausible top, panel and frame thickness for room_elevated_workbench-v007; this check passes, without establishing an overall craftsmanship pass.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: room_elevated_workbench-v007 remains visibly simpler and flatter than its approved target in the registered RoomScale renders.

photo_character.evidence: This ArtBrief has no reference photograph; judge this candidate against its approved Visual Director target.
